summary.en: A block is hung on the thread: a point lights on the spine, a short light reaches right along the hook, and the block opens from its left edge along it (width 0 → full, content clipped as it widens). Played backwards, it folds back into the thread.
summary.zh: 一个块挂上线：主干上亮一个点，一道短光向右伸出成挂钩，块从左边沿挂钩展开（宽度从 0 到满，内容随宽度裁切）。倒放就是折回线里。

fits: Bringing an interface block in from the thread, or folding it back.
notFor: A block that should fly in from off-screen; a full-screen panel.

intent.en: Every piece of interface comes out of the thread and goes back into it.
intent.zh: 每块界面都从线里出来、又回到线里。

content.en: Nothing to read in the move: the block's rectangle (its content is the block's).
content.zh: 动作本身没有字：块的位置（内容属于块）。

fits.zh: 把界面块从线上带出来，或折回去。

notFor.zh: 要从画外飞进来的块；整屏面板。

pairs.note: the other way out: squashed into the line

en: Open from the hook's side only; a centred scale-up loses the sense of hanging.
Clip the content with the width: content that fades in after the box looks like a second step.
zh: 只从挂钩那一侧展开；居中放大就没了“挂着”的感觉。
内容随宽度裁切：盒子开完再淡入内容，看起来像多了一步。

source.path: assets/templates/stream/film.js renderChat (the hook: a point 64 px below the block's top, the reach); plan.js cardAt (0.45 s, ease-in-out cubic)

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
